doc.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004

title: The coming year-long hiatus
summary: The band is about to stop for the first time since 1988, after 150-plus shows a year since 1990. Fleck planned a new record to come out when they return.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I’m glad you said that because I had read you had used the word “overview” about your music. And you said it today already. And it sounds like you just described it, like you’ve really got a vision of what it is you guys do and want to continue doing.

Yeah. Well it’s an interesting time right now because we’re about to stop the band for a year. And this is the first time we’ve done this since we got together in ’88. And we started being a full time band in 1990 and we’ve been going nonstop for the whole time, always at least 150 shows a year and many more the first years. And so this year we’ve decided to take a hiatus and that’s going to be — so it’s going to be an interesting year for everybody to not be in the Flecktones for a while. And right now we’re on the last four shows before we hang it up for while. We’ve got a new record that we’ve recorded that is going to come out when we come back so I mean like at the same time as the

motivations for things are not necessarily commerce or whatever, I’m also very thoughtful about existing in the world, in the business world. Like in other words, when we come back, it’s going to be much better if we come back with a new record so that there’s something to promote and something to talk about and new music to play. So I mean it’s like I live in both worlds. I try to be very much of a realist and set the band up in the best possible way while keeping the music what we want it to be. So I thought it was good for us to squeeze out a record right now while we’re playing like a lot. We had the whole last six months have been about working on new music so we’re finishing up the year with a feeling of achievement. We just created a project we’re really proud of and we’re going to put it away for a while and we’re all going to do different things.
